alerts.subject: [C6-MED] Scientist says RAM pricing has risen to normalized 2007 levels, AI shortage undid 20 years of progress in a matter of mo
alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22DRAM%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Sat, 08 Aug 2026 00:46:22 GMT Link: https://news.google.?oc=5 Scientist says RAM pricing has risen to normalized 2007 levels, AI shortage undid 20 years of progress in a matter of months — memory prices had been falling exponentially for decades - tomshardware.com Scientist says RAM pricing has risen to normalized 2007 levels, AI shortage undid 20 years of progress in a matter of months — memory prices had been falling exponentially for decades  tomshardware.com ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A scientist quoted in the coverage says RAM pricing has risen back to normalized 2007 levels, reversing roughly 20 years of exponential memory price declines within a matter of months. 内容: 报道引述一位科学家的话称，RAM 价格已回升到 2007 年的水平，AI 需求带来的短缺在短短几个月内抹平了内存价格约 20 年的指数级下跌。 Why it matters: Memory has historically gotten cheaper every year as a predictable input cost; an AI-driven DRAM/HBM shortage severe enough to erase two decades of price deflation signals demand is badly outrunning fab capacity. That directly raises the bill-of-materials cost for every AI server build, squeezing margins across the hyperscaler/neocloud capex chain. 影响: 内存价格几十年来一直在稳定下跌，是 AI 服务器成本模型里一个可预测的变量。这次由 AI 需求引发的 DRAM/HBM 短缺严重到能抹平 20 年跌势，说明需求已经严重超出晶圆产能。这会直接推高每台 AI 服务器的物料成本，挤压超大规模厂商和 neocloud 整条 capex 链的利润空间。

The 10-year TIPS real yield jumped to 2.43% (2026-08-06), up 0.54pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.89%.

10 年期 TIPS 实际收益率 2026-08-06 升至 2.43%，比过去 90 天低点 1.89% 高出 0.54 个百分点。

Rising real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration AI capex bets and make debt-funded data-center buildouts more expensive to service — a classic tightening-liquidity stress signal for the bubble thesis.

实际收益率上升会推高长久期 AI capex 押注的折现率，也让靠举债建数据中心的成本变高——这是流动性收紧压力的典型信号，对泡沫压力论是利空。

alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22HBM%22+OR+%22memory+chip%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 09:13:10 GMT Link: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE5GcTVkb1RWSzNiZVhweThRUVBBbWs3Z3VsSGlhbWJtWUVIcmFsN3BNLTJEVm1zRUE2WXZadjJ6UWpnVUlLSndhMFVGZXp3VG5fQV8tNjgzck54SEYycjZxbE9nTVZYUmQ5c045QnVxSjdBMW9v?oc=5 Nvidia Weighs Lower Specs Amid HBM Shortage - Businesskorea Nvidia Weighs Lower Specs Amid HBM Shortage  Businesskorea ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: News reports say Nvidia is weighing lower memory specifications for its chips because of an HBM (high-bandwidth memory) shortage. 内容: 有报道称，由于 HBM（高带宽内存）短缺，Nvidia 正考虑下调芯片的内存规格。 Why it matters: HBM is the binding constraint on AI accelerator output, not compute silicon — if Nvidia has to downgrade specs to keep shipping, it confirms memory supply, not fab capacity or demand, is the current bottleneck on hyperscaler AI buildouts. A prolonged HBM shortage also feeds through to memory-maker pricing power, another leg of the capex-cost-inflation thesis. 影响: HBM 是 AI 加速卡产出的真正瓶颈，不是计算芯片本身——如果 Nvidia 要靠降规格才能维持出货，说明现在卡脖子的是内存供应，不是晶圆产能或需求不足。HBM 长期短缺也会传导到内存厂商的定价权上，是 capex 成本通胀逻辑的又一条支线。

alerts.subject: [C11-HIGH] SpaceX Short Bets Reach $23.6 Billion to Surpass Tesla Ahead of First Wave of Share Unlocking and Earnings - TradingKey
alerts.body: Severity: HIGH Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=SpaceX+OR+SPCX+stock+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 13:08:44 GMT Link: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxQNmdVQnhPRkJHODFqVjZIVTJNM2IxMWN5aDliaGZaZGtxQ1o2YUYzZWFiRE5ndUV6OU5VMXJ6Z2dwZkowcHIwRlJ4MEhwZ3hVRzN3NHgwQzV2R2RBVUZXUVJpUEZFZDEwZnFjcm1abHAxR1pYU3lOMERDT0xkSzFlbnoxRUJRaTN2aE5uMVZpeFBqMUJpRzFKRlBqaTRFaW5Pc1RaMFltajBqc0otUngzOXQ0MHQ0RGdXc0NtZ1hyV1h6bThzX3RBN2xn?oc=5 SpaceX Short Bets Reach $23.6 Billion to Surpass Tesla Ahead of First Wave of Share Unlocking and Earnings - TradingKey SpaceX Short Bets Reach $23.6 Billion to Surpass Tesla Ahead of First Wave of Share Unlocking and Earnings  TradingKey ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: Google News aggregated coverage that short interest against SpaceX has hit $23.6B, surpassing Tesla, right before the first tranche of insider share unlocks and an earnings report. 内容: Google News 报道称，做空 SpaceX 的仓位已达 $23.6B，超过 Tesla，就在首批股份解禁和财报公布之前。 Why it matters: A record short bet arriving right at the unlock/earnings catalyst raises the odds of a volatile post-unlock print — heavy insider selling into an already-crowded short book is exactly the kind of index-mechanics stress C11 is built to catch, distinct from mission-coverage noise. 影响: 在解禁和财报这个关键节点上出现创纪录的做空规模，意味着解禁后大概率出现剧烈波动——内部人抛售撞上本已拥挤的空头仓位，正是 C11 要捕捉的指数机制性压力信号，和纯粹的报道类噪音不同。

alerts.subject: [C6-MED] PC Giants Turn to Chinese Memory Chips as AI-Driven Shortage Bites - finance.biggo.com
alerts.body: Severity: MED Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22DRAM%22+price+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 05:55:00 GMT Link: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE9qMWNYQjFUTmE5bGxoN2RqQjhDanRUNVFiRE9GbzNyWDVaWlVUVGhjTWNXLXI3YkQ0Qk1fa3dIVVhoU2FnNXR2aGRfR1dhMXJabmZFMy1IendDQm9VcDdkYUZ2RHh4a1ViWUJzcnVxY2U1UWdzQkE?oc=5 PC Giants Turn to Chinese Memory Chips as AI-Driven Shortage Bites - finance.biggo.com PC Giants Turn to Chinese Memory Chips as AI-Driven Shortage Bites  finance.biggo.com ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: A finance.biggo.com article reports PC makers are shifting purchases to Chinese memory suppliers as an AI-driven DRAM/NAND shortage bites. 内容: finance.biggo.com 的一篇报道称，由于 AI 驱动的 DRAM/NAND 短缺加剧，PC 厂商正转向采购中国内存芯片。 Why it matters: Memory supply is being pulled into AI accelerators (HBM/DRAM) hard enough to squeeze the consumer PC channel and push buyers toward alternate Chinese suppliers — a direct sign that AI-driven demand is outrunning fab capacity, a classic late-cycle capex-stress tell. 影响: 内存供应正被 AI 加速器（HBM/DRAM）大量占用，挤压到消费级 PC 供应链，迫使厂商转向中国替代供应商——这直接说明 AI 需求已经超出晶圆产能，是典型的周期晚期资本开支承压信号。

alerts.subject: [C11-HIGH] SpaceX earnings under scrutiny amid Starlink funding demands as $104 billion share unlock approaches - TechStock²
alerts.body: Severity: HIGH Feed: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=SpaceX+OR+SPCX+stock+when:1d&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en Published: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 09:00:01 GMT Link: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxOYjJHVEo2TEdjNjRTMjMzV2ZraHpjSzFxRjhCMS15aHRNal9SemVYVlh2TUM3UmpCNDYwU2RqLXAxOFFyMmR0b1M2OVVtVUMzODdxcE9VbDJFMWpoSGp2ekQ2bmM4NnNNOElWRDFmVW1wa1ZWR2dxZlNMeTl5QXR6WUdCWU11bXY1eGM1VU5nQlRqNm5Lb3NvUHdxMjdLc1V4bmR1OC1jOE1tSU9pUDQyWTBFNlVaRmhaeDhRdQ?oc=5 SpaceX earnings under scrutiny amid Starlink funding demands as $104 billion share unlock approaches - TechStock² SpaceX earnings under scrutiny amid Starlink funding demands as $104 billion share unlock approaches  TechStock² ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── What this means: SpaceX earnings are reportedly under scrutiny amid Starlink funding demands as its estimated $104B share unlock date approaches. 内容: 有报道称，随着 SpaceX 约 $104B 规模的股票解禁临近，其财报表现和 Starlink 融资需求正受到密切关注。 Why it matters: Media focus on funding pressure right before a major lock-up expiry raises the odds of concentrated post-unlock selling, which matters for the passive-flow/index-mechanics thesis around single-name AI-adjacent exposure. 影响: 在大额解禁前夕媒体聚焦其融资压力，提高了解禁后集中抛售的概率，这对与 AI 相关的单一个股在被动资金/指数机制层面的风险敞口判断很关键。
